g.text: Drawing MFG-EX-SCR-01 | Part EX-SCR-01 — 16 mm x 16D single screw | Qty 1
Rev final-design-fabrication-closure-v0.8 | Units mm | Scale NTS, dimensions govern | Third-angle projection | source commit
Material: SCM440 (KS D3867/JIS G4105 equivalent) QT + gas nitride | Process/finish: turn between centres, 4-axis flight mill, polish, nitride,
Overall: X 15.871 × Y 15.871 × Z 316.000 mm | general tolerance ISO 2768-m unless noted
Critical: total 316.00; active 256.00; OD 15.92 -0.02/0; RH pitch 16.00; land 1.60; Datum A axis from Ø12 h6 and Ø15 h6 journals; SCM440 QT 28–32
HRC; gas nitride 0.30–0.50 mm, surface 900–1100 HV; flight OD TIR ≤0.05/256; OD Ra≤0.8 µm
GD&T/datums: A=common journal/bore axis; B=drive/feed datum face; C=feed-port angular plane; verify datum marking on supplier inspection report
Inspection: CMM/caliper against STEP and drawing; deburr and visual crack/warp inspection; certified material/heat-treatment report;
Edges: remove burrs; break unspecified sharp edges C0.3–0.5. No unapproved material/tolerance substitution.
Release: PASS — physical validation NOT_RUN; procurement and machining USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
